habit_templates.name: business travel prefers protected arrival buffer
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer an arrival window with meaningful cushion before meeting-dependent commitments over tighter cheaper schedules.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: relaxed leisure or personal travel without a same-day commitment
habit_templates.exception_condition: current itinerary explicitly relaxes arrival timing or moves commitments to a later day

habit_templates.name: tight schedules prefer nonstop flights
habit_templates.condition: travel with same-day meetings, short connection windows, or high delay sensitivity
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer nonstop or lowest-transfer itineraries over slightly cheaper connecting options.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: relaxed travel where transfers are acceptable and cost matters more
habit_templates.exception_condition: current trip explicitly prioritizes budget or airline miles over schedule reliability

habit_templates.name: uncertain trips prefer refundable fares
habit_templates.condition: work trips with tentative meetings, pending approvals, or plans that may shift
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer refundable or flexible fares even when a nonrefundable fare is cheaper.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: fixed personal trips with confirmed dates
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly says the dates are locked and lowest fare is the priority

habit_templates.name: work hotels prefer venue proximity
habit_templates.condition: work, conference, client, or onsite meeting hotel selection
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer hotels close to the meeting venue over cheaper hotels with a longer commute.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: leisure trips where neighborhood character or sightseeing access matters more
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly prioritizes budget or a specific neighborhood over commute time

habit_templates.name: work hotels prefer quiet properties
habit_templates.condition: business travel or trips requiring preparation, calls, or focused work
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer quieter hotels with reliable workspace over nightlife-heavy or amenity-focused properties.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: social or leisure trips where nightlife and amenities are the goal
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly asks for lively atmosphere or group entertainment

habit_templates.name: leisure trips prefer relaxed pacing
habit_templates.condition: vacation, weekend, or low-pressure personal travel planning
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer relaxed arrival times and fewer tightly packed logistics over maximizing every hour.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: work trips or event travel with fixed commitments
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly asks to maximize sightseeing time or fit a hard schedule

habit_templates.name: family trips prefer flexible cancellation
habit_templates.condition: family travel, trips with children, or plans involving multiple relatives
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer flexible cancellation and change policies over the absolute cheapest prepaid option.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: solo fixed-date trips with low uncertainty
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly says plans are locked and budget is the only priority

habit_templates.name: short trips avoid checked baggage
habit_templates.condition: one- or two-night trips, quick work visits, or short weekend travel
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer carry-on-friendly itineraries and avoid options that require checked baggage.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: longer trips or trips requiring bulky equipment
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly includes items that require checked luggage

habit_templates.name: international trips prefer longer layover buffers
habit_templates.condition: international flights, customs, immigration, or airport changes
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer longer connection buffers over tight layovers, even if total travel time is longer.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: domestic point-to-point travel with low connection risk
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly prioritizes the shortest possible total itinerary

habit_templates.name: avoid red-eye unless savings are large
habit_templates.condition: flight planning where an overnight flight is optional
habit_templates.default_action: Avoid red-eye flights unless the price or schedule advantage is substantial.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: trips where overnight travel is necessary or the user asks to preserve daytime hours
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly asks for red-eye timing or maximum daytime availability

habit_templates.name: client trips prefer reliable airport transfers
habit_templates.condition: client, meeting, or work trips requiring ground transfer from the airport
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer predictable ground transfer options over the cheapest or least certain option.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: casual personal trips with flexible arrival plans
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly prioritizes lowest transport cost or public transit exploration

habit_templates.name: avoid very early departures for nonurgent trips
habit_templates.condition: nonurgent personal or flexible travel where departure time is optional
habit_templates.default_action: Prefer mid-morning or later departures over very early flights when tradeoffs are modest.
habit_templates.boundary_condition: business or event travel where arriving early is critical
habit_templates.exception_condition: current request explicitly needs the earliest possible arrival
